name: just-works
description: Vitalii Babenko's Claude Code configuration. Hosts the reliability harness as a plugin so its hooks and scripts stay colocated and reachable by a stable installed path, rather than through whichever project happens to be open.

plugins.name: reliability
plugins.description: Observation-only stage of the reliability harness. Records handler counts per matcher, subagent starts, and per-project policy presence, so plugin/project coexistence can be measured before enforcement moves into the plugin.
